purpose: Machine-readable evidence table for G Track measures used by the IQ Mindware website, route builder and pilot documentation.

records.construct: stability of task engagement during repetitive responding
records.approved_public_wording: Estimates engagement stability during a repetitive attention task.
records.required_caveat: Performance also reflects response strategy, speed-accuracy trade-offs and motor control; it does not identify the cause of a low score.
validation_needs: prospective validity against an independent task

records.construct: withholding a frequent response when an infrequent NoGo event occurs
records.approved_public_wording: Tracks response-control stability alongside response speed and variability.
records.required_caveat: Commission errors must be interpreted jointly with omissions, response time, anticipations and variability.

records.construct: selection of task-relevant response information despite semantic interference
records.approved_public_wording: Estimates task-focused control when relevant and irrelevant information conflict.
records.required_caveat: The robust group-level Stroop effect does not guarantee reliable individual-difference measurement from a simple interference difference score.

records.construct: resolution of response competition from surrounding distractors
records.approved_public_wording: Estimates selective attention when surrounding information points towards a competing response.
records.required_caveat: Reliability depends on trial count, timing, condition balance and scoring; a simple congruency difference should not stand alone.

records.construct: joint profile of engagement, response policy, interference control and performance stability
records.approved_public_wording: Combines complementary indicators of attention and control rather than relying on one test.
records.required_caveat: The exact composite, profile boundaries and longitudinal interpretation remain under prospective validation.

records.construct: current-session task-active profile plus continuous engagement-vigilance context
records.approved_public_wording: A provisional estimate of how today's attention pattern compares with your developing personal baseline.
records.required_caveat: It is not a brain-state detector, diagnosis, cause attribution or proven intervention selector.

records.construct: maintaining spatial locations while performing an interleaved symmetry judgement
records.approved_public_wording: A provisional estimate of visuospatial working-memory capacity under processing load.
records.required_caveat: The task is a custom symmetry-span-style implementation rather than a direct copy of a validated proprietary test.

records.construct: remembering which visual token appeared in which location
records.approved_public_wording: A provisional estimate of visual working-memory binding: remembering what appeared where.
records.required_caveat: The exact stimuli, timing, scoring and reliability of the G Track version require validation.

records.construct: figural matrix reasoning and fluid-reasoning performance
records.approved_public_wording: A matrix-reasoning benchmark based on the validated Open Matrices Item Bank.
records.required_caveat: It is not an official IQ score; the selected form, norms, alternate forms and longitudinal sensitivity require G Track validation.

records.construct: change on separate cognitive measures across a defined programme
records.approved_public_wording: Tracks whether performance changes on separate measures across baseline and follow-up.
records.required_caveat: Practice effects, regression to the mean, alternate forms, timing quality and measurement uncertainty must be addressed; change does not by itself prove broad cognitive improvement.
